tools.name: gib_list_bounties
tools.description: Discover open Gibwork bounties (public listing API, fixture fallback), verify each escrow token account on Solana and rank them by value / competition / deadline. Read-only: no wallet, no signature, no submission.

top.description: How many ranked bounties to return (default: config top, max 50).

min_value_usd.description: Only return entries whose ranked value is at least this many USD.

only_verified.description: Only return bounties whose escrow matched the platform ledger.

tools.name: gib_verify_escrow
tools.description: Read a Solana SPL token account with the public RPC (getAccountInfo jsonParsed + getTokenAccountBalance) and compare it with a bounty escrow or a raw address. Returns verified / mismatch / unknown.

bounty_id.description: Gibwork bounty id to look up in the latest snapshot.

escrow_address.description: Raw Solana token account address to verify.

expected_amount.description: Optional platform-stated balance to compare against.

tools.name: gib_snapshot_diff
tools.description: Compare two Escrow Sentinel snapshots (defaults: newest capture vs the committed baseline) and report new bounties, closed bounties, escrow balance moves and submission-count changes.

tools.name: gib_report
tools.description: Run the full Escrow Sentinel pipeline (discover + escrow verification + ranking + diff) and return the complete report as JSON.
